private lemma weight_le_delta_aux {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) {r : Option τ → ℕ}
    (hratio : ∀ j, (r none : ℝ) ≤ δ * r (some j)) {d : τ →₀ ℕ} (hd : d.degree ≤ r none) :
    weight (r ∘ some) d ≤ δ := by
  classical
  by_cases hr : r none = 0
  · rw [(Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff d).1 (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (hr ▸ hd))]
    simpa [weight] using hδ
  have hrp : (0 : ℝ) < r none := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr
  calc weight (r ∘ some) d = ∑ j, (d j : ℝ) / r (some j) := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ j, (d j : ℝ) * δ / r none := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (pos_of_mul_pos_right (hrp.trans_le (hratio j)) hδ) hrp, mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hratio j) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = δ * d.degree / r none := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_mul, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Nat.cast_sum, mul_comm]
    _ ≤ δ := (div_le_iff₀ hrp).2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast hd) hδ)
inline_related.classification: related real-ratio weight bound, not exact same statement; target natural m cannot encode r_none/delta for arbitrary real delta

\theta = \ind(R; \frac{h_1}{q_1}, \dots, \frac{h_p}{q_p}; r_1, \dots, r_p).
$$
    Let $i_1, \dots, i_{p-1}$ be non-negative integers such that $w=i_1+\cdots+i_{p-1}\leq l-1$.  If
    $$
    \Delta_{i_1, \dots, i_{p-1}} \frac{1}{\nu !} \frac{\partial^\nu}{\partial x_p^\nu} R(x_1, \dots, x_p)
    $$
    is not identically zero, then
    $$
    \ind (\Delta_{i_1, \dots, i_{p-1}} \frac{1}{\nu !} \frac{\partial^\nu}{\partial x_p^\nu} R(x_1, \dots, x_p); \frac{h_1}{q_1}, \dots, \frac{h_p}{q_p}; r_1, \dots, r_p)
    $$
    $$
    \geq \theta - \frac{i_1}{r_1}- \cdots - \frac{i_{p-1}}{r_{p-1}}- \frac{\nu}{r_p}
    $$
    $$
    \geq \theta - \frac{w}{r_{p-1}}- \frac{\nu}{r_p}.
    $$
    We have
    $$
    \frac{w}{r_{p-1}} \leq \frac{l-1}{r_{p-1}} \leq \frac{r_p}{r_{p-1}} < \delta.
